violation_type.title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on the DFPS investigation, a child was disciplined by pinching their ear, which resulted in bruising.

finding_variants.text: Based on the DFPS investigation, a child was disciplined by pinching their ear, which resulted in bruising.
The allegation is related to a DFPS abuse/neglect investigation and found to be deficient. Based on interviews with children and daycare staff, it was determined a caregiver thumped children in care.
During the investigation it was found that some of the caregivers were using  forms of prohibited punishment, such as hitting, to control unwanted behaviors from the  children in their care.
A caregiver used inappropriate discipline when they tapped a child on the head with an object.
During an investigation it was found that a caregiver hit a child on their leg/bottom area as a form of discipline.
Based on interviews it was determined that a caregiver used inappropriate discipline on a child in care.
